title: Is there a bug on the forum when viewing "topics" and "replies"?
content:
Hello everyone, I’d like to report two issues I’m experiencing with the forum:

  1. When I go to my profile, under ‘Topics’, and open any topic, I get this error page. However, if I open that thread from the notification panel , then it does open it for me. I’ve compared the two URLs and the endings are different.

    2) In a thread (the only one) that opens, when I click on ‘show previous replies’, the replies don’t load – nothing happens. I’ve tried several devices and several browsers

scraped_replies.html: Opening ‘Topics’ from my profile is currently working for me.

It seems to be working now – how odd.

So it must be my problem then; perhaps I’ll clear my browser cache or look for other solutions.

Thanks!

So it must be my problem then;

Not necessarily - the forum does seem to have a number of “intermittent” issues ...
